{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:")
print(df.dtypes)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("\nUnique revenue values (first 10):", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check status
print("\nUnique values in status:", df['status'].unique())

# Check converted
print("\nValue counts in converted:", df['converted'].value_counts())"}
